description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance Payable to Worker in the Cocoa, Cardamam and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payable to workers in the cocoa, cardamom, and pepper growing and manufacturing trade, based on the Cost of Living Index Number. This falls under public sector administration of worker benefits and service conditions, specifically addressing wage adjustments, which is classified under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8).
